bind_tcp.description: Bind to a TCP address and port (e.g., listen on all interfaces). Overrides `port`.

bind_unix.description: Bind to a Unix domain socket (common in production behind reverse proxies).

path.description: Path to the Unix socket file

umask.description: Umask for the socket (e.g., 0600 → 384 in decimal)

port.description: Port to listen on (deprecated in favor of `bind_tcp`)

threads.description: Thread pool size: minimum and maximum threads per worker.

min.description: Minimum number of threads per worker

max.description: Maximum number of threads per worker

workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn (set >1 for multi-core CPU usage)

preload_app.description: Preload the application in the master process (requires careful fork-handling)

app_root.description: Directory path where your Rack application resides

ruby_executable.description: Path to Ruby executable to use for worker processes (leave empty for default)

rackup.description: Path to `config.ru` (Rackup file); defaults to `config.ru` in app_root

state_path.description: Path for Puma's state file (stores PID, control socket location)

log_file.description: Redirect worker stdout/stderr to log files (optional).

worker_timeout.description: Seconds before a hanging request is terminated

worker_boot_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for worker boot (e.g., app load)

tcp_keepalive.description: TCP keepalive interval in seconds (Unix/Linux only)

worker_shutdown_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for graceful worker shutdown

min_workers.description: Minimum number of workers to keep during phased restarts (overrides `workers` in some versions)

max_workers.description: Maximum number of workers (for dynamic scaling in some forks)

control_server.description: Enable the Puma control server (allows runtime restart, stop, etc.).

ssl.description: Enable HTTPS with SSL/TLS (bind to port directly or via reverse proxy).

plugins.description: List of Puma plugin names to load (e.g., ['tmp/restart.txt'])

custom_config.description: Raw Ruby code block for advanced or version-specific settings (e.g., `on_worker_boot { ... }`)
